description: Manage packages for FreeBSD using portinstall.

parameters.name: use_packages
parameters.description: Use packages instead of ports whenever available. Choices: false true ← (default)

examples:
- name: Install package foo
  community.general.portinstall:
    name: foo
    state: present

- name: Install package security/cyrus-sasl2-saslauthd
  community.general.portinstall:
    name: security/cyrus-sasl2-saslauthd
    state: present

- name: Remove packages foo and bar
  community.general.portinstall:
    name: foo,bar
    state: absent
